title: Declare Phoenix test commands and ignore generated submodule runtime
outcome: Land exactly termal-tests.toml and the prerequisite script's self-ignore setup under Greg's explicit one-commit authorization.
acceptance: The root declaration provides one exact build-enabled net10.0 dotnet test command and distinct ignored TRX path for each of the five existing test projects.

Prerequisite preparation preserves existing child .gitignore files, creates missing self-ignore rules for generated .codenav runtime, and keeps pinned upstream commits and tracked child trees unchanged.
The exact two-file change passes repository-required validation and independent review, then lands in one explicitly scoped commit without unrelated paths.
